add.name: google-workspace
add.purpose: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets and Docs through OAuth and a small Python wrapper that uses the gws CLI as backend when installed; includes setup scripts and a daily-brief procedure.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on Google Docs/Sheets/Drive/Gmail tasks; one-time OAuth setup with a Google Cloud client secret (scripts/setup.py).
add.evidence: NousResearch/hermes-agent 251k stars; skillsmp top result for 'google workspace'/'google docs'
add.notes: Written for Hermes Agent paths; scripts are portable Python. Public open-licensed answer to a 'google-workspace' skill (Anthropic's own google-workspace skill is not published in any anthropics repo).

add.name: gws-docs
add.purpose: Reference skill for the Google Workspace CLI's Docs API (documents get/create/batchUpdate) with a +write helper for appending text.
add.how_to_use: Use with the gws CLI installed and authorised (read gws-shared first for auth); create/edit Google Docs from the terminal.
add.evidence: googleworkspace/cli 31k stars (Google Workspace org, Apache-2.0); skills.sh ~55.6k installs (gws-docs-write ~47.8k)
add.notes: CLI-reference style; requires gws binary and OAuth.

add.name: gws-sheets
add.purpose: Reference skill for the gws CLI's Sheets API with +read and +append helpers for reading ranges and appending rows.
add.how_to_use: Use with gws installed/authorised to read or write Google Sheets.
add.evidence: googleworkspace/cli 31k stars (Google Workspace org, Apache-2.0); skills.sh ~56k installs (gws-sheets-read ~48k)

add.name: gws-slides
add.purpose: Reference skill for the gws CLI's Slides API (create, get, batchUpdate presentations and pages).
add.how_to_use: Use with gws installed/authorised to create or edit Google Slides decks.
add.evidence: googleworkspace/cli 31k stars (Google Workspace org, Apache-2.0); skills.sh ~40k installs

add.name: gws-drive
add.purpose: Reference skill for the gws CLI's Drive API (files, folders, permissions, shared drives) with a +upload helper.
add.how_to_use: Use with gws installed/authorised to manage Google Drive files.
add.evidence: googleworkspace/cli 31k stars (Google Workspace org, Apache-2.0); skills.sh ~71.7k installs

add.name: gog
add.purpose: Drives the gog CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets and Docs, including headless OAuth setup and safe handling of credentials.
add.how_to_use: Requires the gog CLI (brew install gogcli) and one-time OAuth.

add.name: slidev
add.purpose: Official Slidev skill: build web-based developer slide decks in Markdown with Vue components, code highlighting, animations and presenter features.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on technical presentations/conference talks; needs Node and the Slidev CLI.
add.evidence: Official Slidev repo 48.9k stars; skills.sh ~12k (official) + ~14k (antfu/skills copy)

add.name: baoyu-slide-deck
add.purpose: Turns content into a slide deck: writes an outline with style instructions, then generates each slide as an image and assembles them.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'create slides'/'make a presentation'; needs an image-generation backend configured per the baoyu-skills README.
add.notes: Slides are images, not editable text.

add.name: guizang-ppt-skill
add.purpose: Generates a horizontal-paging web PPT as a single HTML file (WebGL backgrounds, speaker view, audience sync, notes, section covers, data and image-grid templates) in two editorial styles.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on requests for an HTML/web presentation; output is one self-contained HTML file. Instructions are in Chinese.
add.notes: AGPL-3.0 copyleft; SKILL.md at repo root.

add.name: lark-doc
add.purpose: Official Lark/Feishu skill for reading, creating and editing cloud documents (Docx/Wiki), inserting or downloading images and attachments.
add.how_to_use: Requires the lark-cli (larksuite/cli) and a Lark/Feishu account; read lark-shared for auth. Instructions are in Chinese.
add.evidence: Official Lark Suite CLI 17.5k stars; skills.sh lark-doc ~460k installs (larksuite/cli) + ~740k (open.feishu.cn)
add.notes: Install counts look very high relative to stars; included for being vendor-official. Sibling skills: lark-sheets, lark-slides, lark-drive.
